description: Favorites: sixteen buttons, each holding one HC-1 favourites file, so a set list can be loaded with one click
notes: this module does nothing on its own: it needs an HC-1 in the patch, which it finds by itself, so it can be placed anywhere in the rack rather than beside it
the buttons come up empty: right-click one to choose a favourites file, or drag a file onto it, before it does anything
clicking a button loads its file into the HC-1 Favorite tab and lights the button; clicking it again makes HC-1 forget the file, leaving the favourites themselves listed
the sixteen buttons are drawn by the module rather than built as knobs, so no click on them reaches this help
for more than sixteen files, add a second Favorites module
save the module as a Rack preset once it is set up, and the same set of files can be brought into other patches
